info.title: ExamKeep API
info.description: Multi-tenant CBT platform API. Error envelope and idempotency contract: ADR-0033.

scope.description: Absent when this capability is only reachable via break-glass (breakGlass=true).

breakGlass.description: ADR-0012: reachable only through the audited break-glass path, never an ordinary grant.

studentPasswordlessSignIn.description: Some students of this school may sign in with Login ID + name right now — the sign-in page offers the student form.

school.description: null when the request resolved no school (platform host, unrecognised subdomain, or the bare root domain).

identifier.description: Login identifier — username or school-issued student ID.

roles.description: Active RoleAssignment.role values for this membership (02).

passwordless.description: Signed in with Login ID + name (passwordless student sign-in): no password change is asked for or allowed.

identifier.description: The staff login identifier to send a reset link for. Students have no email — see A-02.

name.description: First name and surname in any order and any capitals; middle names optional.

allStudents.description: On for every student of the school.

classIds.description: Classes switched on individually. A PUT replaces the whole list.

declaredMimeType.description: Client-declared MIME type — never trusted alone; complete() re-derives it by sniffing.

declaredSizeBytes.description: Used to pin Content-Length on the presigned PUT.

challengeToken.description: Present only when status is mfa_required. Single-use, 5 minutes.

required.description: Whether the platform enforces a second factor for Software Admin.

otpauthUri.description: otpauth:// URI, for a QR code.

recoveryCodes.description: Shown exactly once — never retrievable again.

signedOut.description: How many other sessions were ended.

mustChangePassword.description: True while the account is still on the temporary password it was emailed; every route but the password change, sign-out, this one and two-step setup answers PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED until it is changed.

mfaEnrolled.description: A confirmed second factor is on file.

overridden.description: True when changed from the env value.

value.description: The new value (seconds for a duration), or null to return to the default.

studentCount.description: Active SchoolMembership count with a STUDENT role.

adminEmail.description: The admin's email — where the activation key is sent.

adminLoginIdentifier.description: The login identifier this admin will use to sign in once activated (unique per school, ADR-0005) — distinct from their email.

exams.description: Every persisted Exam row for this school, across all statuses (matches B17 analytics semantics).

attempts.description: Every persisted ExamAttempt row for this school (B13/B17).

examsConducted.description: Exams do not exist until B11 — always 0 until then, not fabricated.

attempts.description: Attempts do not exist until B13 — always 0 until then, not fabricated.

computedAt.description: When the worker sweeper last computed this snapshot; null if it has never run.

expiredPendingCount.description: Upload requested (presigned PUT issued) but never completed before the URL expired.

supersededLogoCount.description: A READY, SCHOOL_LOGO-typed asset no school's logoMediaId points to anymore.

uncheckedReadyCount.description: READY, non-SCHOOL_LOGO assets — nothing references these until B8 (Question/QuestionMedia). Not classified as orphaned or not; counted here only so this report never silently overstates its own coverage.

computedAt.description: When the worker sweeper last computed this snapshot; null if it has never run.

newPassword.description: Required for an INITIAL_ACTIVATION-purpose key; the admin has no password yet.

status.description: F5 gap-closure: gained an accurate enum: (matching SchoolSubscriptionSummaryDto's own precedent) — was plain type: String before, a real typing gap tsc caught building the first frontend consumer.

inGracePeriod.description: Whether the school is currently within ADR-0015's post-expiry grace window.

declaredMimeType.description: Client-declared MIME type — never trusted alone; complete() re-derives it by sniffing.

declaredSizeBytes.description: Used to pin Content-Length on the presigned PUT.

logoUrl.description: Long-lived signed URL (ADR-0021: "logo may be cacheable") — never a bare public object.

palette.description: Computed fresh on every read (never cached) via @atlas/domain's derivePalette. Null when primaryColor is unset.

logoMediaId.description: A READY, SCHOOL_LOGO-typed asset id from this school's own upload — re-validated server-side (type/status/tenant), which is the real gate here, not a second permission check. Pass null to remove the current logo.

primaryColor.description: "#rrggbb". Pass null to clear (falls back to the platform default palette).

resultPolicy.description: Who releases a result by default: TEACHER / SCHOOL_ADMIN / AUTOMATIC (05 §47).

resultDetailVisibility.description: What a student sees once a result is released (ADR-0010’s second axis).

resultPolicyLocked.description: Whether a teacher may override the seeded resultPolicy on their own exams (B15 enforces this; F5 only stores the flag).

defaultExamDurationSeconds.description: Default exam duration in whole seconds; null means no default.

scope.description: Validated export scope; identifiers are checked server-side.

departmentId.description: Null for classes with no department (e.g. JSS levels before streaming).
ADR-0001: a subject with no department falls outside every HOD's automatic review scope.

url.description: A freshly-signed download URL, generated at read time (never stored — ADR-0021 only requires it to outlive the initial download window).

selectedOptionId.description: This attempt's currently-saved selection for this question, if any.

answerSequenceNumber.description: This question's own current answer sequence number, for the client's offline queue to continue from.

serverTime.description: The server's own current clock, alongside `expiresAt` — the client derives remaining time from the DIFFERENCE between the two, never from its own local clock alone (08 §11.4: the client displays the timer but never defines the authoritative deadline).

mediaKey.description: F20 (ADR-0021 amendment): base64 AES-256-GCM key that decrypts the pre-cached media of this exam. Present only to the attempt owner while the attempt is IN_PROGRESS; null otherwise.

extraTimeSeconds.description: F20 (DoD 3): staff-granted extra time already included in expiresAt, in seconds.

marks.description: Derived — SUM of this section's ExamQuestion.marks (ADR-0029), never stored.

notStartedCount.description: Registration roll-ups for the same authorized cohort — real since B13 (independent ExamAttempt counts; a submitted student is never also counted not-started).

inProgressCount.description: Real since B13 ships ExamAttempt — students with a currently-IN_PROGRESS attempt.

submittedCount.description: Real since B13 ships ExamAttempt — students whose attempt reached SUBMITTED/AUTO_SUBMITTED.

absentCount.description: Real, but only ever non-zero after End Examination (ExamParticipation).

attemptDataAvailable.description: Always true since B13 ships ExamAttempt — retained on the contract only so no future client can ever mistake an uncomputed count for a real zero.

lastSeenAt.description: When the server last heard from this attempt (heartbeat or answer save).

disconnected.description: B23 (M-09, ADR-0020): nothing heard for longer than DISCONNECTED_AFTER_MS (90 s) when the snapshot was computed. A signal for the invigilator, not an attempt state.

signals.description: B23 (M-08, ADR-0020): integrity-signal counts by type — counts, not judgements.

openSince.description: The earliest openedAt/reopenedAt across this exam's currently-OPEN sessions.

pendingAbsence.description: End Examination will record this student absent: authorized, never started, and has not sat another batch.

extraTimeSeconds.description: F20 (DoD 3): extra time on the student's latest participant row, seconds (0 = none).

largerText.description: F20 (DoD 3): larger-text accommodation on the student's latest participant row.

extraTimeSeconds.description: Additional seconds granted, added to Exam.durationSeconds at attempt creation.

sequenceNumber.description: Client-assigned, monotonic per (attempt, question) — ADR-0007. A write whose sequence is <= the currently stored value is rejected.

source.description: Client-reported, informational only — never used for admissibility.

gradeWindowFlag.description: True when this write landed inside the ADR-0003 post-expiry grace window.

rejectionCode.description: The rejection error code, if not accepted.

serverTime.description: The server's current clock. The client counts the exam countdown from it on its own monotonic clock, never from the PC's wall clock.

status.description: NOT_APPLICABLE while the attempt is still IN_PROGRESS (or was invalidated/cancelled — never submitted); PENDING once finalized but not yet fully marked (the queued marking job has not completed); COMPLETE once every question has a recorded result.

attemptId.description: Set only when an attempt is already IN_PROGRESS — the client should resume, not start.

extraTimeSeconds.description: F20 (DoD 3): the caller's own staff-granted extra time for this exam, in seconds (0 when none) — already included in the attempt's server deadline at Start; shown so the student knows.

largerText.description: F20 (DoD 3): the caller's staff-granted larger-text accommodation (07 §9.7).

submittedAttemptId.description: Set when the caller has already submitted this exam and cannot start another attempt: their latest submitted attempt. The client shows the submission confirmation instead of Start.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL of the CIPHERTEXT object.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the ciphertext object.

ready.description: false while the server is still encrypting — poll after retryAfterSeconds.

affectedResultCount.description: Results this action made visible or hid.

reason.description: Mandatory — recorded in the audit trail.
Mandatory — why this result is held back.

targetExamQuestionId.description: VOID_QUESTION only — the ExamQuestion excluded from every affected result.

targetResultId.description: MANUAL_OVERRIDE only — the single result being overridden.

overrideEarnedMarks.description: MANUAL_OVERRIDE only — the earned-marks value set outright.

ungradedOnly.description: RECALCULATE only — "Grade now": touch only results finalised without a grade, and grade them against the school's current scale.

scaleId.description: Omit to create a new scale; supply it to add a version to an existing one.

declaredMimeType.description: Client-declared MIME type — never trusted alone; complete() re-derives it by content.

declaredSizeBytes.description: Used to pin Content-Length on the presigned PUT.

academicSessionId.description: Defaults to the school's current (CURRENT) academic session when omitted — every row's Class resolves against this one session.

targetAcademicSessionId.description: Null for TEACHERS jobs, which have no target session.

rawData.description: The parsed row, keyed by template column name.

targetAcademicSessionId.description: Null for TEACHERS jobs, which have no target session.

id.description: Omit for a new option; include to reference an existing one of this revision.

topicName.description: Free-text topic name, resolved case-insensitively and auto-created on first use (ADR-0001 §3 / DoD item 9) — ignored if topicId is also given.

revisions.description: Full revision history, oldest first — never mutated once APPROVED.

questionIds.description: Question ids to archive, each checked against the single-archive rules.
Question ids whose *current* DRAFT revision should be submitted for review.

submittedAt.description: Proxy for submission time — the revision's own updatedAt while pending, since nothing else mutates it between submission and a decision.

examType.description: Free text (e.g. "First CA", "Mock Examination") — confirmed product decision, not a fixed platform vocabulary (2026-09-03).

classIds.description: ClassGroup ids this exam targets — at least one. All must share school, session, and level with each other and with this exam (ADR-0013).

marks.description: Overrides QuestionRevision.marks for this exam only. Omit to use the default.

accommodations.description: 05 §22 — free text, exam-level only; per-student grants are B12/B13.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable — for logs/debugging, not client branching.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same request (with the same Idempotency-Key, if it had one) could succeed. F13's offline sync queue decides retry-vs-drop from this.

correlationId.description: Correlates this response to server-side logs.

details.description: Present for some error codes — e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR's failing fields.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: ADR-0033: a client-generated UUIDv7, one per logical mutating operation (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE). A replay of the same key returns the original response unchanged; the same key with a different request body is rejected with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_MISMATCH (409), never a silent overwrite. Optional per endpoint — GET/HEAD ignore it entirely.
